text:
maria: Heads-up: seeing GPU Pending across us-central1-a/b for last 20m. CA keeps failing with "Insufficient resources" in zone. Any quick mitigation? cc @sophia

raj: I saw that. quota/zone capacity is the culprit. Autoscaler logs show repeated FailedScaleUp events. Not enough GPUs in those AZs. :grimacing:

ethan: Oncall-bot flagged a rise in OOM and queue backpressure for realtime pods. We should enable cross-cluster failover to europe-west1 as temporary, but need to handle data locality and latency.

sophia: Proposal: implement a "fallback-cluster" routing option in our router. If scale-up in primary cluster fails for X attempts, route new requests to a different cluster/region and mark pods with "routed-from:primary". We can reuse ingress feature flag + canary.

raj: Ops concerns: Stateful workloads with local FS won't failover. For stateless model-serving pods (inference-svc) we can do this. Need to add toleration/affinity relaxer in the admission controller to rewrite topologyConstraints when fallback is allowed.

maria: Example admission mutation idea:
```
if (request.annotations["fallback-ok"] == "true" && scaleUpFailed) {
  add nodeAffinity: { preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution: [{ key: "region", values: ["europe-west1"] }] }
}
```

ethan: Also need to adjust Cluster Autoscaler priorities and quotas: create a "gpu-fallback" node pool in secondary clusters with on-demand capacity and pre-warmed instances (min=2) so cold start is bounded. Cost hit but short-term.

sophia: Agreed. We should also add a controller to monitor CA FailedScaleUp counts and emit a signal via our routing service. Flow:
1) detect zone Insufficient
2) flip route flag for that model
3) mutate PodSpec for new replicas to be schedulable in fallback region
4) update dashboard/alerting

raj: Implementation nit: use taints instead of affinity so fallback pool only accepts mutated pods. Taint: gpu-fallback=true:NoSchedule and add toleration via mutating webhook.

maria: Quick kubectl snippets to create fallback pool with min nodes:
```
gcloud container node-pools create fallback-gpus --cluster=redwood-eu-cluster --region=europe-west1 --machine-type=n1-standard-16 --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-t4,count=1 --min-nodes=2 --max-nodes=20
```

ethan: Also add PDBs to avoid cascading disruptions. And ensure we roll API keys/certs for cross-cluster TLS trust.

sophia: I'll draft the playbook and PR with webhook + controller. Can we schedule a 30m sync? Prefer in 20m.

maria: SGTM. I'll prepare monitoring queries: CA events, pending pods by nodeSelector, route flag metric.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042, paging oncall+infra. https://incidents/redwood/INC-2026-042

raj: One more: check cloud provider spot eviction rate. If spot shortages triggered fallback, we should prefer on-demand fallback pools.

maria: noted. I'll add cost tag and alert on fallback-hours > 1h.

sophia: Thanks team. PR link soon. :rocket:
